name: the 👁️ column-visibility strip loses its u flag
why: Without u, the 📊 in the class contributes its two UTF-16 halves as separate members, so the high half \uD83D is also stripped from 🔗 and every other emoji that shares it. The label becomes '\uDD17 Links': present, non-empty, still ending in 'Links', so only an exact comparison sees it.

name: the source guard sees the same lost flag
why: The same planted defect, seen from the guard that covers the call sites the DOM spec cannot reach.

name: _sortColumnHeaderName loses its u flag
why: A call site no DOM spec in this pair exercises. Only the source guard can see it, which is the reason the guard exists.

name: U+FE0F written after ⚠ again in the action-cell strip
why: The combined-character case: [\u26a0\ufe0f] reads as the ⚠️ emoji but is two members, with or without u. The set is unchanged by the reorder, so only the source guard can tell.
